diagnostic_source:
"""Native reached-ancestry contact coordinates on four authenticated saved poses."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import sys
P=Path('/tmp/a1-body-projective-rotation-20260928.py')
b=P.read_bytes()
if hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()!='21927f716974828074849e0517631a8fccfca74bcb508b3f68db45395c48e1f5':
    raise RuntimeError('reviewed projective reference changed')
exec(compile(b.decode().split("\nif __name__=='__main__':",1)[0],'<reviewed geometry definitions>','exec'),globals())
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve()
CFBUILD=Path('/tmp/guala-body-common-frame.i2o5cxoi')
PARENTS={
 'FB-01aj-kinematic-reference.json':'18361902ad5b7ba1cb4b64a6d9541782e159ed20e14588b884a36b81b8fcb878',
 'FB-01aj-projective-rotation-reference.json':'117ef970e25990955d9371abea2d65c4463ee54f5d8ebe047b15fdf0cf6acb4e'}
CFHASH={
 'src/engine/engine_collision_box.c':'536802eaac0a74264fbd10eb220a8250981e802247dd331b9727dd6d7353890f',
 'src/engine/engine_collision_driver.c':'54427b0f8f2843a62cdc72b5bb16398e3d0714e015c9bbcbdc6af308589e117d',
 'src/engine/engine_collision_primitive.h':'e1982c786afafd69767474cfa0d1c70e0b1c747b78cfee8263797cde8559837e',
 'src/engine/engine_core_smooth.c':'200d21016a028aa4b30be290c6dfdea13a366d0846d96c5e8440e24888bde461',
 'src/engine/engine_core_smooth.h':'efb00c541a1778edfe6a8e3caabe86bf370e63ec11238c68a109ad0ce3be8511',
 'src/engine/engine_core_util.c':'b315b96b94c9a64f67290a4a64bba3fe5f4683f80820e19e2f5a3ad1a8f6451a',
 'src/engine/engine_core_util.h':'ea0f3fde9fe59b2cc5e02be8cebe333f13706d5c8d3c0803b4b7f8b574fbdf25',
 'proof_adapter.c':'12aaca43b113ce35937aa1130c82a27b3bfe6baabe4b49f2db5f4f80763f921e',
 'exports.map':'226dec713bfd3c7fd0205167acf300f418ab7d63a3664bc29119260b74b08594'}
SCHEMA_OUT='guala.functional-body.native-common-frame.v1'
TARGET_NAME='FB-01aj-native-common-frame.json'


def check_sources():
    check_kinematic_sources()
    for p,s in CFHASH.items():
        require(hashlib.sha256((CFBUILD/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==s,'source changed: '+p)
    for p,s in (
      ('native/functional_body/common_frame.patch','c849741afcedc424b22bb2ac816ae253023933d5983f2d7ba1bd736ec7eb0bea'),
      ('native/functional_body/rotation_geometry.patch','1e861d76670004d7f4deb471dd753a466f7ca82165108e35ae67a830291aa98c'),
      ('/tmp/guala-body-projective-geometry.XA8uqHVT/engine_util_spatial.c','28fa727f1f2afc3a7434839dbdcb62aff5dd089634d49b7067d712074e3ce0f0')):
        require(hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==s,'prerequisite changed: '+p)


def diagnostic():
    parents=dict(PARENTS)
    source=ACCEPTED.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==ACCEPTED_SHA,'observation definitions changed')
    exec(compile(source.decode().split('\nresult=dict(schema=SCHEMA,completed=False',1)[0],'<observation definitions>','exec'),globals())
    import ctypes
    import subprocess
    result=dict(schema=SCHEMA_OUT,completed=False,failure=None,first_failure=None,
        attempts=0,calls=0,kinematics_calls=0,poses=[],controls=[],
        evidence_complete=True,rollback_exact=False,mounted=False,full_body_qualification=False,
        scope='native kinematics and contact fragment; no integrated motion, force, cold or production proof')
    native=mj.mj_forward;calls=0;cleaning=False;c=None;entry=None;entry_dt=None
    began=time.process_time()

    def forward(m,d):
        nonlocal calls
        require(calls<8 and (cleaning or time.process_time()-began<5.),'bounded forward allowance exhausted')
        calls+=1;native(m,d)
        require(not d.warning.number.any(),'native warning')
        interval._finite(d.qacc)

    def capture(row):
        if c is not None:
            try:row['actual_state']=failed_state(c)
            except Exception as error:
                row['state_capture_error']=repr(error);result['evidence_complete']=False

    def payload(name):
        raw=Path('docs/evidence',name).read_bytes()
        require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==parents[name],'parent changed')
        e=json.loads(raw)
        require(e['measurement_recorded'] and e['diagnostic_completed'] and
            e['execution']['exit_code']==0 and not e['execution']['survivors'],'parent incomplete')
        p=e['raw_measurement'];raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(p['payload_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
        require(len(raw)==p['raw_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==p['raw_sha256'],'parent payload changed')
        return json.loads(raw)

    try:
        check_sources()
        target=CFBUILD/'contact.so'
        require(not target.exists(),'fresh native fragment required')
        upstream=Path('/tmp/guala-body-midpoint.igj32n8c/source')
        original=Path('/tmp/guala-body-midpoint.igj32n8c/build/lib/libmujoco.so.3.3.7')
        common=['/usr/bin/cc','-std=c11','-D_GNU_SOURCE','-O2','-fPIC','-fvisibility=hidden',
                '-ffunction-sections','-fdata-sections','-fno-fast-math','-ffp-contract=off',
                '-Werror=implicit-function-declaration','-I'+str(CFBUILD/'src'),
                '-I'+str(upstream/'include'),'-I'+str(upstream/'src')]
        command=common+['-shared','-Wl,-Bsymbolic-functions','-Wl,--gc-sections',
            '-Wl,--version-script='+str(CFBUILD/'exports.map'),
            str(CFBUILD/'src/engine/engine_core_smooth.c'),str(CFBUILD/'src/engine/engine_core_util.c'),
            '/tmp/guala-body-projective-geometry.XA8uqHVT/engine_util_spatial.c',
            str(CFBUILD/'proof_adapter.c'),str(original),'-Wl,-rpath,'+str(original.parent),
            '-lm','-o',str(target)]
        result['build']=dict(command=command,completed=False,source_sha256=CFHASH)
        run=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
        result['build'].update(returncode=run.returncode,stdout=run.stdout,stderr=run.stderr)
        require(run.returncode==0,'native geometry fragment build failed')
        result['build'].update(completed=True,library_sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
        # Driver no longer filters in world coordinates. Compile its changed
        # consumer with the same headers, without linking or executing it here.
        command=common+['-fsyntax-only',str(CFBUILD/'src/engine/engine_collision_driver.c')]
        result['driver_compile']=dict(command=command,completed=False)
        run=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
        result['driver_compile'].update(returncode=run.returncode,stdout=run.stdout,stderr=run.stderr)
        require(run.returncode==0,'driver consumer compile failed')
        result['driver_compile']['completed']=True
        lib=ctypes.CDLL(str(target))
        class Guard(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_=[('kind',ctypes.c_int),('feature',ctypes.c_int*4),('depth',ctypes.c_double),('separation_squared',ctypes.c_double)]
        class Guards(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_=[('branch',ctypes.c_int*11),('count',ctypes.c_int),('overflow',ctypes.c_int),
                ('margin',ctypes.c_double),('margin_squared',ctypes.c_double),('guard',Guard*50)]
        class Proof(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_=[('guards',Guards),('ancestor',ctypes.c_int),('count',ctypes.c_int),
                ('local_count',ctypes.c_int),('error',ctypes.c_int),
                ('stack_before',ctypes.c_size_t),('stack_after',ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('base_before',ctypes.c_size_t),('base_after',ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('pos',ctypes.c_double*6),('mat',ctypes.c_double*18),
                ('local',(ctypes.c_double*10)*50),('world',(ctypes.c_double*10)*50)]
        lib.a1_pair_size.restype=ctypes.c_size_t
        require(lib.a1_pair_size()==ctypes.sizeof(Proof),'native readout ABI differs')
        lib.a1_kinematics.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p];lib.a1_kinematics.restype=ctypes.c_int
        for name in ('a1_pair','a1_geometry'):
            f=getattr(lib,name);f.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.POINTER(Proof)];f.restype=None

        def observe(output,row):
            row['native_bytes_hex']=bytes(output).hex()
            row.update(ancestor=output.ancestor,count=output.count,local_count=output.local_count,error=output.error,
                stack=[output.stack_before,output.stack_after,output.base_before,output.base_after],
                pos=list(output.pos),mat=list(output.mat),branch=list(output.guards.branch),
                overflow=output.guards.overflow,guard_count=output.guards.count)
            if 0<=output.count<=50:row['world_contacts']=[list(x) for x in output.world[:output.count]]
            if 0<=output.local_count<=50:row['local_contacts']=[list(x) for x in output.local[:output.local_count]]
            if 0<=output.guards.count<=50:
                row['guards']=[dict(identity=[x.kind,*x.feature],depth=x.depth) for x in output.guards.guard[:output.guards.count]]

        def invoke(name,pair,row):
            out=Proof();row.update(operation=name,pair=list(pair),before_state=failed_state(c))
            try:getattr(lib,name)(c.m._address,c.d._address,*pair,ctypes.byref(out))
            finally:
                observe(out,row);capture(row)
            return out

        def parsed(v):return [parsed(x) for x in v] if isinstance(v,list) else float(v)
        def bits(v):return np.asarray(v,dtype='<f8').tobytes()
        def flat(v):
            return [y for x in v for y in flat(x)] if isinstance(v,list) else [v]
        def geometry_differences(actual,references):
            # Measurements against retained references, not a new tolerance.
            observations=[]
            from decimal import localcontext
            with localcontext() as context:
                context.prec=90
                for precision in (40,80):
                    ref=next(x for x in references if x['precision']==precision)
                    fields={}
                    for key,values in actual.items():
                        differences=[abs(Decimal.from_float(float(a))-Decimal(str(b)))
                                     for a,b in zip(flat(values),flat(ref['geometry'][key]))]
                        require(len(flat(values))==len(flat(ref['geometry'][key])),
                                'reference geometry shape differs')
                        fields[key]=dict(max_abs_error=str(max(differences)),
                                         component_abs_errors=[str(x) for x in differences])
                    observations.append(dict(precision=precision,reference_geometry=ref['geometry'],
                                             errors=fields))
            return observations
        def geom():
            d=c.d
            return dict(pos1=d.geom_xpos[pair[0]].tolist(),pos2=d.geom_xpos[pair[1]].tolist(),
                mat1=d.geom_xmat[pair[0]].reshape(3,3).tolist(),mat2=d.geom_xmat[pair[1]].reshape(3,3).tolist())

        data=payload('FB-01aj-kinematic-reference.json')
        reference=payload('FB-01aj-projective-rotation-reference.json')
        require(len(data['poses'])==len(reference['poses'])==4,'four saved poses required')
        pair=tuple(data['anatomy']['pair'])
        # Both archived interior stages generated two contacts. The corrected
        # local selected feature remains admitted at all four saved poses.
        # Require that two-contact manifold here; never impose it at runtime.
        witnesses=[x for x in data['poses'] if x['label'] in ('stage-0','stage-1')]
        require(len(witnesses)==2 and all(x['contact_count']==x['expected_count']==2
                                        for x in witnesses),'cardinality witness changed')
        expected_count=2
        result['cardinality_expectation']=dict(expected_filtered_count=expected_count,
            provenance_receipt='FB-01aj-kinematic-reference.json',
            provenance_sha256=parents['FB-01aj-kinematic-reference.json'],
            archived_counts=[dict(label=x['label'],count=x['contact_count'],
                                  expected_count=x['expected_count']) for x in data['poses']],
            basis='Two-contact interior witnesses; corrected selected feature admitted at all four poses. Diagnostic only.')
        result['construction']=dict(created=False)
        mj.mj_forward=forward
        try:
            c=Trajectory(100,archived_controls()[100]);result['construction']['created']=True
        finally:capture(result['construction'])
        entry,entry_dt=primary(c.e),float(c.m.opt.timestep)

        for saved,expected in zip(data['poses'],reference['poses']):
            row=dict(label=saved['label'],expected_raw_base64=saved['expected_raw_base64'],
                     time_s=saved['time_s'],completed=False);result['poses'].append(row)
            try:
                restore(c,saved['expected_raw_base64'],saved['time_s'])
                before=primary(c.e)
                row['kinematics_before']=failed_state(c)
                try:row['kinematics_code']=lib.a1_kinematics(c.m._address,c.d._address)
                finally:
                    result['kinematics_calls']+=1;row['world_geometry']=geom();capture(row)
                require(row['kinematics_code']==0 and primary(c.e)==before,'kinematics changed physical state or failed')
                expected_world=next(x for x in expected['world'] if x['precision']==0)
                row['world_reference_differences']=geometry_differences(row['world_geometry'],expected['world'])
                row['world_geometry_bitwise_equal']=all(bits(row['world_geometry'][k])==
                    bits(parsed(expected_world['geometry'][k])) for k in row['world_geometry'])
                require(row['world_geometry_bitwise_equal'],'world kinematic refactor differs')
                out=invoke('a1_pair',pair,row)
                require(not out.error and not out.guards.overflow and 0<=out.guards.count<=50
                    and out.stack_before==out.stack_after and out.base_before==out.base_after
                    and primary(c.e)==before,'pair error, stack leak or physical state mutation')
                expected_local=next(x for x in expected['local'] if x['precision']==0)
                want=expected_local['geometry']
                local_geometry=dict(pos1=list(out.pos[:3]),pos2=list(out.pos[3:]),
                    mat1=np.asarray(out.mat[:9]).reshape(3,3).tolist(),
                    mat2=np.asarray(out.mat[9:]).reshape(3,3).tolist())
                row['local_reference_differences']=geometry_differences(local_geometry,expected['local'])
                row['local_geometry_bitwise_equal']=(
                    bits(out.pos)==bits(parsed(want['pos1'])+parsed(want['pos2'])) and
                    bits(out.mat)==bits(parsed(want['mat1'])+parsed(want['mat2'])))
                require(row['local_geometry_bitwise_equal'],'native local geometry differs')
                chosen=[x for x in row['guards'] if x['identity']==data['feature']]
                require(out.ancestor==4 and row['branch']==data['branch'] and len(chosen)==1,'generating frame/feature differs')
                row['selected_depth']=chosen[0]['depth']
                require(row['selected_depth']==float(expected_local['depth']) and row['selected_depth']<=0,
                    'saved selected contact not preserved')
                row['expected_filtered_count']=expected_count
                require(out.count==out.local_count==expected_count,'filtered contact cardinality differs')
                R=c.d.xmat[out.ancestor].reshape(3,3).tolist();origin=c.d.xpos[out.ancestor].tolist()
                row['frame_to_world']=dict(rotation=R,origin=origin)
                errors=[];transform_bits=[]
                for local,world in zip(row['local_contacts'],row['world_contacts']):
                    def rot(v):return [sum(a*b for a,b in zip(r,v)) for r in R]
                    predicted=[local[0],*[a+b for a,b in zip(rot(local[1:4]),origin)],*rot(local[4:7]),*rot(local[7:10])]
                    errors.append(max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(predicted,world)))
                    transform_bits.append(bits(predicted)==bits(world))
                row['world_transform_max_error']=max(errors)
                row['world_transform_bitwise_equal']=transform_bits
                require(all(transform_bits),'world contact transform differs')
                row['completed']=True
            finally:capture(row)

        # No geometry/collision result from these controls is physical motion.
        for label,p in (('invalid-low',(-1,pair[1])),('invalid-high',(c.m.ngeom,pair[1])),
                        ('same-body',(pair[0],pair[0]))):
            row=dict(label=label,completed=False);result['controls'].append(row)
            out=invoke('a1_geometry',p,row)
            require(out.stack_before==out.stack_after and out.base_before==out.base_after,'control stack changed')
            require(row['before_state']==row['actual_state'],'control physical state changed')
            if label.startswith('invalid'):
                require(out.error==1 and not any(out.pos) and not any(out.mat),'invalid geom failed to refuse before output')
            else:require(out.error==0 and out.ancestor==int(c.m.geom_bodyid[pair[0]]),'same-body frame differs')
            row['completed']=True
        root=lambda body: root(int(c.m.body_parentid[body])) if c.m.body_parentid[body] else body
        other=next(g for g in range(c.m.ngeom) if root(int(c.m.geom_bodyid[g]))!=root(int(c.m.geom_bodyid[pair[0]])))
        row=dict(label='world-common-ancestor',completed=False);result['controls'].append(row)
        out=invoke('a1_geometry',(pair[0],other),row)
        require(not out.error and out.ancestor==0 and out.stack_before==out.stack_after and out.base_before==out.base_after,
                'world control ancestry differs')
        row['world_geometry_bitwise_equal']=(
            bits(out.pos)==bits([c.d.geom_xpos[pair[0]],c.d.geom_xpos[other]]) and
            bits(out.mat)==bits([c.d.geom_xmat[pair[0]],c.d.geom_xmat[other]]))
        require(row['before_state']==row['actual_state'] and row['world_geometry_bitwise_equal'],
                'world control changed')
        row['completed']=True
        result['completed']=True
    except Exception as error:
        result['failure']=dict(type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc(limit=8))
    finally:
        if c is not None:
            capture(result)
            if entry is not None:
                try:
                    cleaning=True;mj.mj_resetData(c.m,c.d)
                    interval._restore(c.e,np.frombuffer(entry,dtype='<f8').copy(),entry_dt)
                    result['rollback_exact']=primary(c.e)==entry and float(c.m.opt.timestep)==entry_dt
                except Exception as error:
                    result['rollback_error']=repr(error);result['evidence_complete']=False
        mj.mj_forward=native
        try:
            check_sources()
            if result.get('build',{}).get('completed'):
                result['library_sha256_after']=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                require(result['library_sha256_after']==result['build']['library_sha256'],'loaded fragment changed')
        except Exception as error:
            result['source_post_error']=repr(error);result['evidence_complete']=False
        result.update(calls=calls,cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-began)
        if not result['evidence_complete'] or not result['rollback_exact'] or result['cpu_seconds']>=5.:
            result['completed']=False
    print(json.dumps(encode(result)),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1:]==['--child']:diagnostic()
    else:
        check_sources()
        try:run_static_fixture()
        finally:check_sources()
